component.name: Clatch
component.summary: Switch Claude Desktop accounts without signing out

description.p: Clatch keeps each of your Claude Desktop accounts signed in and switches between them for you, from the notification area or with a keyboard shortcut.

ul.li: One at a time: one Claude, and Clatch swaps the account.
Side by side: each account gets its own Claude window.
An Alt+Tab-style profile switcher and a launcher for every profile.

description.p: Clatch never reads, stores or sends your credentials: it only moves Claude's own data folders on your computer.
